description: This file contains the implementation of the MonthlyCompoundingPeriod class, which handles interest calculation logic for a specific period in a savings account, including methods for calculating interest based on different methods (daily balance, average daily balance) and for filtering end-of-day balances within a period.

classes.name: MonthlyCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Implements interest calculation for a specific period, supporting different calculation methods and filtering end-of-day balances within the period.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a MonthlyCompoundingPeriod instance, filtering balances within the period interval up to the specified date.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the specified interest calculation method and period type.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using the average daily balance over the period.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on daily or monthly balances in the period.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters the list of end-of-day balances to those within the specified period interval, capped at the end date.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the period interval for this interest period.
